notes: panda_control v3 / step5d (gen_excitation_traj.py). Two-band sinusoid per axis on x, y, z plus yaw (about world z, drives J1) and roll (about EE local z, drives J5/J7). Reproduces the step5d_20260525_143929 collection that carried weight 1.5 in their best fit. Per-axis bands are module constants in panda_traj.py: x (0.15, 0.70), y (0.20, 0.90), z (0.30, 1.10), yaw (0.18, 0.55), roll (0.22, 0.65) Hz. The stated amplitude is the LOW band's -- sin + 0.2*sin peaks at 1.2x it. The envelope is ramp-IN ONLY, so the episode ends mid-swing; pass --ramp-out-s to add a tail (not upstream behaviour).
